incident-bot: [ALERT] PagerDuty triggered — service=redwood-inference-prod check=latency_p99 region=eu-west1 p99=1.42s threshold=1.2s SLO_burn=18% (5m)
incident-bot: Links: <https://dashboards.internal/redwood/latency?svc=inference-prod|p99 dashboard> • <https://runbooks.internal/oncall/latency-p99|runbook>
PagerDuty: INC-2301 created and paged maya (on-call)
maya: acked. I'm on it. Starting triage — checking region pods, autoscaler, KV cache.
maya: gathering quick metrics: recent pods showing high cpu and some OOM kills? pulling logs now.
ryan: pinging in. I can jump on the KV cache front and check eviction rates.
anita: I'm seeing a burst of large embedding requests from a single client, ~6k reqs/5m, lots of tail tokens. Possible workload spike.
tom: support report: several customers reporting app slowdowns, one SE reported 10s+ responses. I'll collect session ids.
maya: ok, action plan — 1) throttle bulk-embedding route, 2) temporarily route non-critical traffic to fallback model variant, 3) restart unhealthy sidecars to clear stuck queues.
maya: executing throttle rule now: applying rate limit for route=/v1/embeddings (burst=200, rate=2r/s) — will report.
ryan: KV eviction logs — found rapid evictions around 6924501070. snippet:
```
[2026-03-15T02:14:30Z] kvcache: evict key=ctx-0x7f9 size=48MB reason=approx_lru
[2026-03-15T02:14:31Z] kvcache: evict key=ctx-0x8c3 size=60MB reason=eviction_pressure
```
ryan: looks like memory pressure on the sidecar. Increasing sidecar mem limit while we scale.
anita: scaling dedicated pool in eu-west1 by +2 instances (gpu-n1-standard-8) — ETA ~2m. Also enabling autoscaler override to avoid immediate downscale.
elena: thumbs on routing change. If you need to flip route we have admin API. Example to route to fallback:
```
curl -X POST https://api-internal.redwood/switch-route \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" \
  -d '{"service":"inference-prod","from":"rwd/llama-13b-q4","to":"rwd/llama-7b-q4-fallback","fraction":0.5}'
```
maya: routed 40% of traffic to fallback variant to reduce tail. Monitoring p99 and cost impact.
pagerduty: INC-2301 status: acknowledged by maya. Escalation suppressed.
maya: after throttling embedding route and routing fallback, p99 dropped to ~0.95s in the last 2m. SLO burn down to 3%.
anita: scale completed. New instances registered and sidecar mem bumped. No further OOMs in logs.
tom: CS update: notified affected customers, flagged for follow-up. Logged 12 sessions with >5s — captured traces.
ryan: still seeing occasional spikes correlated with a hot-key user pattern. Suggest warming KV cache for that user or pinning their tokens to separate pool.
maya: temporary mitigation accepted — warming cache for top offenders and creating a per-tenant rate limit plan.
elena: I'll open a postmortem stub and add links to dashboard + collected traces: <https://incidents.internal/INC-2301|INC-2301>
maya: handing off in 30m to night oncall (ryan will be primary). I'll leave monitoring and runbook notes. :white_check_mark:
ryan: acked handoff. I'll keep watch and start retro when stable.
maya: final check — p99 at 0.88s over last 5m. Closing pager for now, moving to monitoring-only. :thumbsup:
incident-bot: PagerDuty INC-2301 status changed to resolved by maya
maya: re-opening if we see regressions, otherwise document mitigations in PM. Thanks all.
